transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm here because I just can't seem to keep my work in order anymore. I work at a dry cleaner, and... I don't know. The tickets, the receipts, workshop notes, customer jobs... they just end up all piled together. I look at it and I just... I don't know what to handle first. So, yeah. I figured I should come in.
Have you had trouble staying organized and keeping track of things since you were a child?

Um... yeah, I suppose so. Even back in grade school... my teachers used to tell my mom I was bright, but just... scattered. I was always losing my papers. And, um, talking out of turn, I guess. They always had to remind me to actually finish my work. So... yeah.
Do you often act or speak before thinking?

I guess so... yeah. Sometimes I just... jump in. Like, if my daughter is asking me something, or a customer at the counter... or even during training at work. I'll just blurt out an answer before they even finish their sentence. And then... well, sometimes I realize I didn't even answer what they were actually going to ask. So... yes.
Do you often have trouble keeping your attention on a task, even when you want to focus?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Like... when I start going over the day's dry-cleaning orders, I usually start out fine. But... well, after a few minutes, my mind just goes somewhere else. I'll start thinking about the clothing labels, or... choir plans, or just something at home. And then I realize I missed half of what I was actually supposed to check. So... yeah. I do.
Do you feel driven to arrange or organize things in a very exact way?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I do that.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days?
No... I wouldn't say that. I feel fine, mostly.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying about many different things?
Um... no. Not really. I mean... I have normal things to think about, but I don't really spend my time just worrying about everything. So... no.
